title: Your PCS orders' effective date
line: The effective date of your PCS orders is the day you report, minus the days of travel time you actually used, plus one day: report on 10 June after 7 days on the road and it's 4 June. Your weight allowance and whether DLA is paid at the with-dependent rate are set as of that date.

sources.title: How to Compute a PCS Order’s Effective Date (computation example CE-MPDT-22)
sources.quote: These computation examples illustrate how to determine a Service member’s PCS order effective date.

sources.title: How to Compute a PCS Order’s Effective Date (computation example CE-MPDT-22)
sources.quote: 1. Determine authorized and actual reporting date. 10 June 2. Minus 7 days of travel time actually used. 3 June 3. Add 1 day. 4 June

sources.title: Joint Travel Regulations
sources.quote: The authorized PCS weight allowance is normally determined by a Service member’s pay grade on the effective date of the PCS order, and whether the Service member has dependents on the effective date of the PCS order.

sources.title: Joint Travel Regulations
sources.quote: For DLA purposes, a Service member with a dependent is one who, on the effective date of a PCS or ITDY order, has a dependent authorized transportation under that order.
